name: Art-Cut-Techs Barbershop
address: 2843 E State Blvd, Fort Wayne, IN 46805
headline:
Barbershop in
Fort Wayne, with a family vibe.
leadText: Art-Cut-Techs Barbershop at 2843 E State Blvd, Fort Wayne. Customers say a friendly shop, walk-ins welcome and kids made comfortable.
reviews: Great local shop a friendly folks that accepted me as a walk in respectfully and they engaged conversation. Mixture of ages in the shop both of customers and staff.

Great place! I got a great cut! I brought my son (almost 3 years old) who only had one cut before. His first cut, not here, was screaming and hated it. Here they made him super comfortable and he was content literally the entire time. Great atmosphere..great staff!
Amazing cleanly place, Always a good atmosphere, Barbers are always super laid-back and chill willing to talk to the customers.

theme.note: from the blue and black on the shop's own logo
